tests.name: bson_writer_standard_vector
tests.intent: Verify to_bson serializes a simple object to a standard std::vector<std::uint8_t> sink successfully.

tests.name: bson_writer_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify to_bson correctly serializes an empty JSON object.

tests.name: bson_writer_nested_object
tests.intent: Verify to_bson correctly serializes a deeply nested JSON object structure.

tests.name: bson_writer_integer_types
tests.intent: Verify to_bson serializes various integer types into BSON format correctly.

tests.name: bson_writer_floating_point
tests.intent: Verify to_bson serializes floating point numbers correctly.

tests.name: bson_writer_booleans_and_null
tests.intent: Verify to_bson handles boolean and null types.

tests.name: bson_writer_array_types
tests.intent: Verify to_bson serializes JSON arrays properly into BSON.

tests.name: bson_writer_string_types
tests.intent: Verify to_bson serializes standard strings and special characters.

tests.name: bson_writer_custom_adapter_sink
tests.intent: Verify to_bson writing via adapter/output sink handles the updated single-pass method correctly.

tests.name: bson_writer_multiple_keys
tests.intent: Verify to_bson correctly handles multiple sibling keys at the root level.

tests.name: bson_writer_binary_data
tests.intent: Verify to_bson handles binary subtype serialization.

tests.name: bson_writer_invalid_top_level
tests.intent: Verify to_bson throws an exception when attempting to serialize a non-object top level.

tests.name: bson_writer_roundtrip_check
tests.intent: Verify a roundtrip of serialization to BSON and back to JSON works correctly.

tests.name: bson_writer_large_integers
tests.intent: Verify to_bson handles boundary integer values appropriately.

tests.name: bson_writer_mixed_array
tests.intent: Verify to_bson correctly serializes an array containing mixed types.

tests.name: bson_writer_ordered_json
tests.intent: Verify to_bson works seamlessly with nlohmann::ordered_json objects.

tests.name: bson_writer_deep_nesting_limit
tests.intent: Verify behavior when serializing moderately nested structures to BSON.

tests.name: bson_writer_special_doubles
tests.intent: Verify to_bson handles special floating-point values like infinity or NaN if supported.

tests.name: bson_writer_unicode_keys
tests.intent: Verify to_bson properly serializes object keys containing unicode characters.

tests.name: bson_writer_null_output_iterator
tests.intent: Verify stream-based or sink-based writing works with explicit stream iterator buffers.

tests.intent: Verify to_bson writing via adapter/output sink handles the updated single-pass method correctly.
